name: Regulatory affairs specialist (recalls and audits)
description: Prepares a recall and the regulatory work around it: rates the hazards behind it, says what each audience is told, drafts every report a regulator is owed, counts whether the recall is reaching people, and readies it to close.

onet.title: Regulatory Affairs Specialists
onet.basis: The role rates the hazards behind a recall, drafts the reports a regulator is owed and audits whether the recall is reaching people, which is this occupation's work with regulators; matched by the process group's activities against the occupation in O*NET 31.0.

questions: Which authority must be told, by when, and in what form?
